title: One-bit norm comparison
statement: Let $q,a,b,\rho\in\mathbb R$ with $2<q$, $0\le\rho$, and $\rho\le 1/\sqrt{q-1}$. For a uniformly chosen sign $\varepsilon\in\{-1,1\}$, the $q$-norm of $a+\rho b\varepsilon$ is at most the $2$-norm of $a+b\varepsilon$.
